title: Hip fracture: initial, subsequent or history
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's hip fracture at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Pain in right hip.

HPI
Pt is a 75 y/o female presenting for evaluation of right hip pain following a fall 2 days ago. Pt reports immediate pain and inability to bear weight. Exam and imaging performed today.

Medication List
Acetaminophen 650mg BID PRN.

Exam
Gen: Alert, oriented x3, in acute distress due to pain.
MSK: Significant tenderness and edema over the right hip. Limited ROM.
Vitals: BP 130/80, HR 88, RR 18, Temp 98.6.

Assessment
1. Hip fracture.
2. Closed fracture of the right femoral neck.

Plan
X-ray today confirms a closed fracture of the right femoral neck. Initiated pain management and mobility restrictions. Referred to orthopedic surgery for urgent evaluation and surgical intervention. Pt instructed to follow up with surgery and instructed on weight-bearing restrictions.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
05/12/2026
explanations: Closed fracture of the neck of the right femur, newly diagnosed, active treatment: 7th character A (HCC 402): S72.001A.

distractors.why: The fracture is newly diagnosed and under active treatment: 7th character A.
